name: Sample School Fixture
description: Minimal example fixture demonstrating all supported fields. Copy this file and customize for your test cases.

promptInstructions.system: You are an AI assistant helping parents filter school emails. Analyze the following email and determine if it contains actionable information for any of the following children.
promptInstructions.relevance: Set send=true if the email contains actionable info (events, deadlines, required actions, schedule changes) for the listed children.
promptInstructions.summaryConcise: If send=true, provide a clear subject line and a concise, 2-3 bullet-point summary highlighting required actions. Use short bullets, no prose.
promptInstructions.responseFormat: Respond with JSON: { "send": boolean, "subject": string or null, "summary": string or null, "children": array of child names this email is about, or null }.
promptInstructions.noSend: If send=false, no subject or summary needed.

testEmails.description: Actionable: class-specific DOCX with deadline. Should send for Alex only.
testEmails.subject: Science Fair Guidelines
testEmails.body:
Hello Room 12 families,

Please find attached the guidelines for our upcoming Science Fair. Topic proposals are due by November 15th.

Best,
Ms. Smith

testEmails.description: Informational only: school garden photos. No action needed, should not send.
